reason: A DSH Web floating novel-reading panel with web novel search, catalog navigation, chapter fetching, local reading progress, bookshelf history, and adjacent-chapter prefetching.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH Web 中提供可拖动和缩放的悬浮小说阅读面板，支持小说搜索、目录浏览、章节阅读以及本地书架和阅读进度保存。
summaries.en: A floating, resizable novel reader for DSH Web that supports novel search, catalog browsing, chapter reading, and local bookshelf and reading-progress storage.

capabilities: Fetches and parses publicly accessible novel pages through host-side /novel routes
Provides novel search, paginated catalogs, and chapter reading in a floating panel
Stores bookshelf, reading history, progress, and panel layout locally in localStorage
Prefetches adjacent chapters for reading navigation
